items.title: Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: listen to anything Johnny Mandel wrote or Robert Farnon who was the daddy of all the arrangers.

ctx.x: Well I like those words, especially at 9:50 in the morning. Terrific sentiments.

No but if you want to hear great arrangements, listen to anything Johnny Mandel wrote or Robert Farnon who was the daddy of all the arrangers. He’s got some great albums, Schwartz and Dietz songs, made in England, unbelievable orchestrations.
A recent Joe Williams record he did.
